summary: This Form 8-K reports the consummation of a business combination (de-SPAC) between GigCapital7 Corp. (a SPAC) and Hadron Energy Operating Company Inc., with the combined entity renamed Hadron Energy, Inc. The transaction closed on May 22, 2026, following shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on May 7, 2026. The Form 8-K provides updates on changes in control, board composition, and registrant status, and includes required financial statements. No specific price per share or premium is stated in this excerpt. The closing marks the transition from shell company to operating energy business, converting public SPAC units into combined company stock and warrants. Watch for post-combination trading performance and any shareholder redemptions.
